resources.string: Each preset pairs a main color with a playback color; Custom lets you pick both.
Used for actions, selected options and the app identity.
Used for playback status and progress. Changing the main color keeps this choice.
Artwork tints stay local to the title. Actions use gold and playback uses blue elsewhere.
One color for actions, selection, playback status and progress.
Use a second color for playback status and progress. Off: everything uses the main color.
